d:
The title track of Bollywood blockbuster 'Wake Up Sid' is a thumping number with Ranbir Kapoor sizzling onscreen, his leading lady's character is played by Konkana Sen Sharma, who plays the role of an aspiring writer. The 2009 movie is directed by Ayan Mukherji and produced by Karan Johar. The story lingers around a young Sid Mehra who is figuring life just as he walks out of his family, away from all the indulgence and into the lap of reality. This number features the voice of Shankar Mahadevan, the music is directed by Shankar-Ehsaan-Loy.
Song Name - Wake Up Sid! Club Mix
